snippet.title: WANDER STARS DATE ANNOUNCEMENT TRAILER!
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM: https://bit.ly/WanderStars
JOIN OUR DISCORD: https://discord.gg/papercastle

*Update!!*
Wander Stars is coming to PC, Nintendo Switch, Xbox Series X/S, and PS5 on September 19th, 2025! 

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Wander Stars is coming to PC and Nintendo Switch on August 1st, 2025! 

Unleash custom attacks by combining words in this Super! Anime! Turn-Based! RPG! Collect all 200 words, earn Pep Ups from honorable victories and become a Kiai master. Befriend your rivals, uncover dark mysteries, and seek out the pieces of the Wanderstar map in a wild race across the universe.
